id: R10-01
source_type: changelog
date: 2026-05-19
product_area: mobile
title: Offline pages on iOS and Android
text: Work offline on mobile

Tessera now works without a connection on iOS and Android. Until now, opening a page on mobile required a network connection, which made Tessera hard to rely on during flights, commutes, or anywhere with weak signal.

**How it works**
- Tap **⋯ → Available offline** on any page to download it to your device, along with its images and attachments
- Recently opened pages (up to your last 50) are also cached automatically
- Offline pages can be read and edited without a connection
- Changes sync automatically when you're back online, and an indicator at the top of each page shows its sync status

**Good to know**
If someone else edits the same block while you're offline, Tessera keeps both versions and asks you which to keep when you reconnect. Databases can be made available offline too, though views with more than 5,000 rows will only download the first 5,000. Offline pages are stored encrypted on your device and are removed when you sign out.

title: Recent pages home screen widget
text: Work offline on mobile

A new home screen widget shows your most recently edited pages, so you can jump back into your work without opening the app first.

To add it, long-press your home screen, tap **+** (iOS) or **Widgets** (Android), and search for Tessera. The widget comes in two sizes: a small version with your three most recent pages, and a medium version with five pages and the time each was last edited.

Tap any page in the widget to open it directly. The widget refreshes every 15 minutes and whenever you close the Tessera app. Widgets show only page titles and icons, so no page content appears on your home screen.

id: R05-02
source_type: changelog
date: 2026-03-03
product_area: mail
title: New mail arrives faster on Android
text: Mail, now in threads

Fixed an issue on Android where new emails could take up to 15 minutes to appear in Tessera Mail when the app was in the background. This was caused by the app's background sync being paused by battery optimization settings on some devices.

Tessera Mail now uses push notifications from our servers to trigger a sync, so new messages arrive within a few seconds on most devices. If you still see delays, check that Tessera is set to **Unrestricted** under your phone's battery settings. This release does not change how messages are grouped or displayed.

id: R11-01

title: Booking links in Tessera Calendar
text: Share your availability

You can now share your availability with anyone using **booking links** in Tessera Calendar. Send a link, and the person on the other end picks a time that works without any back and forth.

**How it works**
1. In Tessera Calendar, click **Share availability → New booking link**
2. Choose a meeting length, the hours you're available, and how much buffer to leave between meetings
3. Copy the link and send it by email, chat, or add it to your signature

When someone books a time, the event is added to your calendar with a video link, and both of you get a confirmation email. Booking links check every calendar you've connected to Tessera, so you won't be double booked.

**Good to know**
People booking a time do not need a Tessera account. You can create multiple booking links for different meeting types and turn any of them off at any time.

Question: Can people use Tessera on mobile without a connection?

answer:
Yes, as of May 19, 2026, Tessera supports offline use on both iOS and Android [R10-01]. 

Key details of offline functionality on mobile include:
* **Downloading pages:** You can download specific pages along with their images and attachments by tapping **⋯ → Available offline** [R10-01].
* **Automatic caching:** Up to your last 50 recently opened pages are automatically cached for offline access [R10-01].
* **Reading & editing:** Offline pages can be read and edited without an internet connection, and changes sync automatically once you are back online [R10-01].
* **Sync status:** An indicator at the top of each page shows its current sync status [R10-01].
* **Conflict resolution:** If someone else edits the same block while you are offline, Tessera preserves both versions and asks you which one to keep upon reconnecting [R10-01].
* **Databases:** Databases can be made available offline, though views exceeding 5,000 rows will only download the first 5,000 rows [R10-01].
* **Security:** Offline pages are encrypted on your device and are removed if you sign out [R10-01].

Prior to this release, users could not open pages on mobile without a network connection, leading to customer complaints regarding flight and commute usage [C035, C048, R10-01].
